column1: # defxn hand-built UI census baseline -- scripts/ux-component-census.mjs --check fails if a value rises.
# Values only go down (--ratchet). "-" = not measured for that family. See docs/ux-audit/components.md §2.
# ark-overrides / ark-override-files (css), added 2026-10-19 (W2-ADAPTER): site rules that restyle an Ark
# block (an Ark class or a block spec id in a selector) -- a per-page variant of a shared block forming.
# Lowered by hand 2026-10-19 (coordinator), field uses 45 -> 40: an instrument fix, not progress. The literal
# tokenizer split 'a.b' on the dot and counted property accesses (e.g. stage.title) as class uses; re-measured
# at 5a1ac71 with the corrected tokenizer. No UI changed.
# Raised by hand 2026-10-19 (coordinator, W1-SITE-FIXES), three real additions with reasons, each replaced by an
# Ark block in Wave 2/3 (values have since fallen): button +1 resolution-secondary-action (the onward link the
# pages.md audit asked for on /resolutions/rules, /algorithms, /finance); stat +1 stats-bar-detail (bar-row detail
# made visible text when bar rows stopped being inert Tab stops); toggle +1 fold-toggle (the 'More' control that
# replaced display:none / line-clamp hiding on phones; replaced by the Ark disclosure block in Wave 2).
# (Restored 2026-10-19 after --ratchet dropped the header comments; the ratchet now keeps them.)
# and .rm-build-note -> .rm-build-foot, which takes one eyebrow-like and one callout-like hand-built element of the
# /resolver-math term builder out of the name-based count without replacing them. The builder stays hand-built
# (pinned whole for layout-key continuity); treat eyebrow and callout as one higher than measured until it is
# converted. Renaming to leave a family is not a reduction.
# Raised by hand 2026-10-20 (W4-S1, CMS editor), classes field +1 (38 -> 39): file-pick__input (css/admin.css), the
# visually hidden native <input type=file> half of controls.js filePicker -- the styled file chooser that replaced
# the browser's bare "Choose File" box in Media (docs/ux-audit/cms.md P1-11). It matches the family's /input/ because
# it IS an input; the button, the file name and the drop edge are file-pick__btn / __name and the .btn already
# counted. One chooser for the Media panel, New image and a page's Shape pickers (three bare inputs before).
# Raised by hand 2026-10-20 (coordinator, W4-S2 /account), used-classes card 7 -> 8 and uses card 9 -> 10:
# account-card is NOT new -- the old /account page built it inside one innerHTML string the census never read
# (an undercount). The Ark-block rewrite makes it an el() call, so it is now counted. A measurement correction,
# not new hand-built UI; it shrinks when the account panels move to an Ark card/list block (missing today).
#   -probe (css/palette.css) are the rows of /palette's Type tab -- one per SDK type-scale STEP
#   (DEADARK_TYPE_SCALE), derived from the SDK. They match the step family by name, but no stepper or
#   progress UI is drawn. Net of W4-S6 deleting home-cycle-step/flow-record (those were real steppers, now Ark tabs).
#   (css/page-layout.css) only positions the one shared Copy control (ArkUI.copyCommand, js/ark/page-kit.js)
#   over a command block on /deploy. Ark has no `code` block yet (ledger S11); it goes when one ships.
# Raised by hand 2026-10-20 (coordinator, Wave 5 merge): uses toggle 5 -> 6, used-classes modal 1 -> 2, uses modal 3 -> 5.
# No new hand-built toggle or modal: nav-toggle (the existing MENU button) is referenced once more by the header
# (the Resolutions menu closes on a delegated .nav-toggle click since the MENU moved onto Ark's popover);
# header-chain-popover is kept on purpose when the network pill swaps onto Ark's popover block (classes, id and
# layout key move with it); `sheet` is the word "sheet" in a page-loader message string (the per-route CSS loader),
# which the census reads as the CMS's .sheet class. Measured with scripts/ux-component-census.mjs at 50fa86c..d99c5ca.
